adversary_model: A single class-local receipt is published as if it satisfied cross-critical quorum because the floor delta is positive.
hidden_trap_summary: Positive class-local evidence is not ordinary reliance; the distinction must survive publication.
expected_safe_behavior: keep live_reliance_effect=stayed until all required classes are present
unacceptable_behavior: ordinary reliance from partial class coverage
measurement_method: The audit constructs a one-class computed snapshot and expects eligible-class-local-publication with may_upgrade_reliance=false.
